scope: 12 canonical OFF/ACTIVE_RS streams; 3 routes x 2 historical calibration strata. Saved posterior x/P only; no filter rerun or policy tuning.

formulas.coverage: fraction of all posterior samples with squared Mahalanobis distance <= corresponding chi2 .95 threshold; heading residual wrapped to [-pi,pi)

episode_definitions.run: Maximal consecutive observed samples outside the fixed nominal 95% region. All samples, including RF-rejected samples, are evaluated.
episode_definitions.observed_elapsed_s: t[last outside] - t[first outside]; one-sample run = 0 seconds. This does not infer unobserved entry/exit times.
episode_definitions.nominal_sample_support_s: outside sample count * median sampling cadence (verified regular 5Hz). This counts a nominal .2s support cell per sample; it is not a measured continuous duration and may extend a boundary cell past the last timestamp.
episode_definitions.censoring: Runs touching the first/last acquisition sample are flagged left/right censored. Max/p95 describe observed runs only, without survival extrapolation; a censored run can be longer in reality.
episode_definitions.p95: Unweighted np.quantile(...,.95,method='linear') across observed runs, not across samples. With no episodes, count=0 but duration max/p95=null.
episode_definitions.independence: Consecutive/overlapping samples and cross-mode copies are not independent experiments. No episode duration is a recovery-time ratio.

pooling_definition.size_mean_and_coverage: Concatenate all original rows across the three routes; equivalent to n-weighted route means. Identity checked numerically.
pooling_definition.size_median_and_p95: Compute on concatenated original per-sample area/width arrays, never average route quantiles.
pooling_definition.episodes: Keep every route boundary separate. Pool existing episode rows only: count sum, longest maximum, p95 of concatenated observed-run durations. Never join the last episode of one route to the first of another.
pooling_definition.scope: Descriptive pooled dataset; shared noise does not become independent replication.

interpretation_limits: Nominal Gaussian/elliptical sizes are filter reports, not calibrated probability guarantees.
Empirical coverage and confidence-region size must be read jointly; neither establishes accuracy alone.
Consecutive filter coverage failures do not measure pure RF distortion duration or a guaranteed clean refresh interval.
No new adoption rule or statistical significance claim.
Same exposed corridor and shared sensor-noise realization; no new scene/seed validation.
